Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Singleton
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 02/07/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 159 as introduced removes the requirement that a majority of a quorum of members of the Board of Trustees of Alabama State University be physically present at meetings conducted by electronic means which could reduce reimbursement expenses, per diem and travel of the board by an estimated $159 per member for each board meeting attended virtually.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs

Committee: State Government
Sponsor: Singleton
Analyst: Daniel Davenport
Date: 03/07/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 159 as introduced could reduce reimbursement expenses, per diem and travel of the Boards of Trustees of Alabama State University and Alabama Agricultural and Mechanical University by an estimated $159 per member for each board meeting attended virtually pursuant to the provisions of this bill.
Chris Pringle, Chair
State Government
